# FPS Limitation Patcher **Removes the FPS limits set by PowerKeeper on MIUI and HyperOS.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - Patches the PowerKeeper app already on your device during install, so it matches your ROM - Supports MIUI and HyperOS, up to Android 16 ## Requirements - MIUI or HyperOS - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Installation takes a while because the app is patched on the device. 4. Reboot your device. ## Notes - If downloads keep failing during installation, try again with a VPN. ---
Made by **[🅺🅰🆂🅷🅸](https://t.me/kakashi1v1)** · part of **[Mods Center](https://github.com/Mods-Center)** [Website](https://modscenter.org) · [Channel](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs) · [Support group](https://t.me/bootloop_discussion) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/issues)

FPS Limitation Patcher

Removes the FPS limits set by PowerKeeper on MIUI and HyperOS.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • Patches the PowerKeeper app already on your device during install, so it matches your ROM
  • Supports MIUI and HyperOS, up to Android 16

    • Requirements

  • MIUI or HyperOS
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/FPS-Limitation-Patcher/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Installation takes a while because the app is patched on the device.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • If downloads keep failing during installation, try again with a VPN.
